name: Narrative Journal
description: Everything the player has learned, written down without being asked. Clues are recorded automatically as they are discovered, because an adventure game that expects note-taking is an adventure game that punishes playing in short sessions. Entries are grouped by the thread they belong to rather than chronologically, since the question a returning player has is 'what was I doing about the safe', not 'what happened at 14:32'. The journal is deliberately a reader and not an oracle: it records what was found and never what to do next, which is ui.hint_system's job and a different promise.

inputs.name: autoRecord
inputs.description: Whether discoveries are written without being asked.

inputs.name: groupBy
inputs.description: How entries are organised: 'thread' answers what a returning player is actually asking; 'time' is a log.

inputs.name: maxEntries
inputs.description: Entries retained before the oldest thread is collapsed.

outputs.name: unread
outputs.description: Entries added since the journal was last opened.
